result.narrative:
Vodafone Idea scores 39.2 and sits in the Watch band, with an implied PD of 0.2923. There is one open overdue notification under policy TCI-SCF-2026-0001, the oldest item 18 days past due, and the payment review records a deteriorating trend: resolution times have lengthened from 5 days to 9 days to the current 18 days, which is still unresolved and already longer than either prior case, with notification frequency also up from 1 to 2 in the 180-day window. The news flow is heavy but mixed: a widened Q2 net loss of INR 5,975 crore reported across three outlets, alongside an additional INR 4,000 crore raise, a routine spectrum renewal in 8 circles the company says will not disrupt services, and a planned BSNL roaming pact.

The band is driven more by news than by payments: 0.65 x 18.0 (payment, 18 DPD) + 0.35 x 78.6 (news) = 39.2, so the news component contributes 27.5 against 11.7 from payments. The news figure comes from a single severity 4 loan_delay item dated 9 days ago, in which the CEO acknowledges that multiple lenders' involvement is delaying a loan. The adjudicator agreed with caveats and should be read before approval: that article's body text is identical to its headline, with no loan size, lender or timeline, so the severity 4 rating is an inference from a headline; Reuters reports the same quarter's loss as narrowing while three other outlets report it widening, so one reading is wrong; the INR 4,000 crore raise is scored as purely negative with no credit for the liquidity it provides; and the payment record does not reconcile, showing owed of INR 40,000,000 against an open invoice described as INR 9.0M, with the notification dated the same day the invoice fell due yet already 18 days past due. The adjudicator also noted the corroborated earnings items (decayed 39.25) would on their own keep the news component well above zero, so the direction of the call holds even if the loan-delay item is discounted.

The recommendation is a REDUCE on the single limit: Meridia Bank's supply chain finance line LIM-IN03-1 cut from INR 120,000,000 to INR 102,634,280, bringing expected loss down from INR 25,254,720 to INR 21,600,000 to meet the 25% appetite against a PD of 0.2923. Maximum liability does not bind. Given the adjudicator's caveats, confirm the true amount at risk and the ageing on N-261106-00006, and verify the loan-delay report, before the reduction goes out.

Lifting this file requires both components to improve. Clearing the 18-day overdue and returning to prompt settlement would strip out the payment contribution, but news alone currently holds the band, so a move to Healthy below 20.0 needs 19.2 points and would also require the loan-delay item to be rescored or to decay, on a 365-day half-life. Confirmation that the lender facility has closed, or evidence that the INR 4,000 crore raise has settled the near-term liquidity question, would be the most direct route down.
